_comment: COMPLETE Set 1 — all 120 collectible + Fulfilled forms + tokens + Leaders + Adversary, encoded for the engine. Human source: docs/04-card-database.md and docs/08-card-additions.md. Verbs: CLAUDE.md section 8; new verbs in _newVerbs.

_newVerbs.shuffleIntoDeck: Put a unit into its owner's deck instead of discard (Jonah).
_newVerbs.discountHand: Reduce cost of card(s) in hand. params: amount, count|target.
_newVerbs.discoverFromDeck: Discover 1-of-N from your own deck. params: count, keep.
_newVerbs.returnToHand: Return a unit from board to owner's hand (Dorcas, Onesimus, Lost Sheep).
_newVerbs.auraBuff: Continuous while-in-play buff (Deborah, David-King, Boaz). params: attack,health,target,scope,condition.
_newVerbs.onHealBonus: Passive: whenever you restore health, restore N more (Zadok).
_newVerbs.gainForEachSheep: Buff self by count of a token type controlled (Jabez).
_newVerbs.conditionalDeal: Deal only if a board condition holds (Gideon's Torches).
_newVerbs.immuneToSpells: Passive: cannot be targeted/damaged by spells (Leviathan, SMA).
_newVerbs.executes_damaged: On-strike: destroy an already-damaged unit (Jael's Tent-Peg).

cards.name: Balaam's Donkey
cards.text: Guard. Arrival: Foresee 1.
cards.flavor: Saw the angel before the prophet did. Nobody ever listens to the donkey. — Numbers 22.
cards.art: A wide-eyed donkey in a mountain pass sensing a faint gold light off-frame; dust, olive hills.

cards.name: Scribe of the Word
cards.text: Arrival: Foresee 2.
cards.flavor: Ink, patience, and absolutely no small talk.
cards.art: A stooped copyist at a slanted desk, candlelit scroll, ink-stained fingers.

cards.name: Samuel the Seer
cards.text: Arrival: Foresee 3.
cards.flavor: Heard his name in the dark and answered before he knew who was calling. — 1 Samuel 3.
cards.art: A boy in linen sitting up in a dark temple, single oil lamp, an unseen voice implied by light.

cards.name: Nathan the Prophet
cards.text: Arrival: set an enemy unit's attack to 1.
cards.flavor: 'You are the man.' Told a king to his face and lived. — 2 Samuel 12.
cards.art: A lean prophet pointing directly at the viewer, throne-room shadows behind.

cards.name: Isaiah
cards.text: Arrival: Foresee 3.
cards.flavor: 'Here am I, send me.' Volunteered before hearing the job description. — Isaiah 6.
cards.art: A robed figure beneath temple pillars, an ember of coal near his lips, seraphic light.

cards.name: Jeremiah
cards.text: At the end of your turn, if an ally died this turn, draw a card.
cards.flavor: The weeping prophet. Right about everything, thanked for none of it.
cards.art: A young man at a broken city gate, rain, scroll clutched to chest.

cards.name: Handwriting on the Wall
cards.text: Set an enemy unit's attack to 1.
cards.flavor: Weighed, measured, found wanting. Bad night for the king. — Daniel 5.
cards.art: A hand of light scrawling glowing letters across a feast-hall wall, overturned goblet.

cards.name: Fire from Heaven
cards.text: Deal 4 to an enemy unit.
cards.flavor: Elijah didn't bring matches. — 1 Kings 18.
cards.art: A column of white-gold fire striking a stone altar from a clear sky.

cards.name: Ezekiel
cards.text: Arrival: return an ally from your discard to your hand.
cards.flavor: Saw wheels within wheels. Nobody's been quite the same since. — Ezekiel 1.
cards.art: A prophet beneath a sky of interlocking rings and eyes, storm-blue, awe.

cards.name: Elisha
cards.text: Arrival: Foresee 2, then restore 2 to your hero.
cards.flavor: Double portion. Also: do not mock the bald man. — 2 Kings 2.
cards.art: A successor lifting a fallen mantle from a riverbank, chariot-fire receding upriver.

cards.name: Jonah
cards.text: If Jonah would die, shuffle him into your deck instead.
cards.flavor: Furious about a plant. We warned you. Big Fish Energy. — Jonah 4.
cards.art: A soaked, scowling man under a wilted vine on a dune, a huge fish shadow out at sea.

cards.name: Word of the Lord
cards.text: Foresee 3.
cards.flavor: Sharper than it looks. Comes true whether you're ready or not.
cards.art: Glowing script unspooling from an open scroll into the air, gold on storm-blue.

cards.name: Deborah the Prophetess
cards.text: Your other units have +1 attack.
cards.flavor: Held court under a palm tree. Everyone came to her. — Judges 4.
cards.art: A seated woman judging beneath a lone palm, warriors kneeling, sunlit authority.

cards.name: Micaiah
cards.text: Arrival: Foresee 2.
cards.flavor: The one prophet who wouldn't just tell the king what he wanted. Unpopular. Correct. — 1 Kings 22.
cards.art: A lone dissenter facing a row of nodding court-prophets, arms crossed, torchlight.

cards.name: Elijah
cards.text: Arrival: deal 3 to the strongest enemy unit. Instead of dying, Elijah is exiled and adds Mantle of Elijah to your hand.
cards.flavor: Didn't die. Took the chariot. Showoff. — 2 Kings 2.
cards.art: A windswept prophet on Carmel, cloak snapping, a chariot of fire in storm-cloud above.

cards.name: Daniel
cards.text: Endure. Fulfill: survive an enemy turn while damaged.
cards.flavor: Slept fine. The lions did not. — Daniel 6.
cards.art: A calm young man seated among dim lions at rest, dawn light through a stone grate.

cards.name: Daniel, the Beloved
cards.text: Endure. Arrival: Foresee 3.
cards.flavor: Untouched by the fire, unmoved by the crown.
cards.art: A serene elder statesman in Babylonian robes, lions calm at his feet, dawn-gold.

cards.name: Moses, Signs & Wonders
cards.text: Arrival: deal 2 to all enemy units.
cards.flavor: Ten warnings. Pharaoh took all ten. — Exodus 9.
cards.art: A staff raised against a bruised sky, hail and fire over a distant city, silhouette on a ridge.

cards.name: Left-Handed Ehud
cards.text: Swift.
cards.flavor: Nobody guards the left. That was the whole plan. — Judges 3.
cards.art: A lean fighter drawing a short blade with his left hand in a shadowed hall.

cards.name: Shamgar
cards.text: Arrival: deal 1 to a unit.
cards.flavor: 600 with an oxgoad. Gets one verse. Absolute legend. — Judges 3:31.
cards.art: A farmer mid-swing with a long ox-goad against raiders, dust and grain.

cards.name: Jonathan
cards.text: Swift. Has +1/+1 while you control a David.
cards.flavor: Gave the crown-prince's own robe to a shepherd. Loyalty over throne. — 1 Samuel 18.
cards.art: A young prince handing his sword and robe to someone off-frame, armor gleaming.

cards.name: Benaiah
cards.text: Endure.
cards.flavor: Killed a lion in a pit on a snowy day. Weirdly specific. Deeply metal. — 2 Samuel 23.
cards.art: A scarred warrior climbing from a snow-dusted pit, lion pelt over one shoulder.

cards.name: Joshua & Caleb
cards.text: Swift.
cards.flavor: Ten spies saw giants. These two saw real estate. — Numbers 14.
cards.art: Two grizzled scouts overlooking a green valley, a giant cluster of grapes on a pole.

cards.name: The Three Mighty Men
cards.text: Guard. Arrival: +1/+1 for each enemy unit.
cards.flavor: Broke an army's line for a cup of water he refused to drink. — 2 Samuel 23.
cards.art: Three armored veterans back-to-back-to-back holding a well against a horde.

cards.name: Gideon's Torches
cards.text: If you have fewer units than the enemy, deal 2 to all enemy units.
cards.flavor: 300 jars, 300 trumpets, zero drawn swords at first. — Judges 7.
cards.art: A hillside erupting with sudden torchlight from clay jars at midnight, camp in panic.

cards.name: Sword of Goliath
cards.text: Give a friendly unit +2/+0.
cards.flavor: Nine feet of the enemy's own craftsmanship, now yours. Warranty void. — 1 Samuel 17.
cards.art: An oversized bronze sword planted point-down in sand, too big for the boy reaching for it.

cards.name: Jael's Tent-Peg
cards.text: +2/+0. Destroys any already-damaged unit it strikes.
cards.flavor: Hospitality with a very large asterisk. — Judges 4.
cards.art: A humble wooden tent-peg and mallet on a woven rug, one ominous shadow.

cards.name: Coronation
cards.text: Give an ally +3/+3 and 'Your other units have +1 attack.'
cards.flavor: Long live the king. — 1 Samuel 16.
cards.art: Oil poured over a kneeling figure's bowed head, gold light haloing without a literal halo.

cards.name: Samson
cards.text: Legacy: deal 2 to all enemy units.
cards.flavor: Brought the whole house down. On purpose. Eventually. — Judges 16.
cards.art: A powerful figure braced between two temple pillars, cracks spidering upward, dust raining.

cards.name: Trumpets at Jericho
cards.text: Destroy the enemy unit with the most health.
cards.flavor: No battering ram. Just a marching band with excellent discipline. — Joshua 6.
cards.art: City walls buckling outward in a cloud of dust as ram's-horn trumpets sound.

cards.name: Shepherd David
cards.text: Giant-Slayer: destroys 4+ attack units he strikes, takes no counter-damage. Fulfill: slay a giant.
cards.flavor: Yes, a 1-drop. Yes, he beats your 6-drop. That's the story. — 1 Samuel 17.
cards.art: A small shepherd boy winding a sling, calm; a vast armored shadow looming; scarlet dusk.

cards.name: David, the King
cards.text: Your other units have +1 attack.
cards.flavor: The shepherd who became the king. Same sling, bigger stakes.
cards.art: A crowned warrior with a harp on his back and shepherd's satchel, sword drawn, scarlet.

cards.name: Solomon the King
cards.text: Arrival: Discover two cards from your deck; keep both.
cards.flavor: Asked for wisdom. Got everything else thrown in. — 1 Kings 3.
cards.art: A crowned figure enthroned between two golden lions, scales and scroll at hand.

cards.name: Josiah, the Boy King
cards.text: Arrival: draw a card.
cards.flavor: Eight years old and already the best of them. — 2 Kings 22.
cards.art: An oversized crown on a small determined child on a great throne, feet not reaching the floor.

cards.name: Abishai
cards.text: Swift.
cards.flavor: Would have finished Saul in the cave. David said no. Loyal to a fault, emphasis on fault. — 1 Samuel 26.
cards.art: A hard-charging warrior with a raised spear at a cave mouth at night, torchlight.

cards.name: Widow of Zarephath
cards.text: At the start of your turn, restore 1 to your hero.
cards.flavor: The jar of flour simply did not run out. Accounting was baffled. — 1 Kings 17.
cards.art: A weary woman tipping an endless trickle of flour from a small clay jar, hearth-glow.

cards.name: Levite Attendant
cards.text: Arrival: give an ally Endure.
cards.flavor: Keeps the lamps lit. Doesn't ask for thanks.
cards.art: A robed servant trimming a golden seven-branched lampstand, incense-blue haze.

cards.name: Physician's Care
cards.text: Restore 4 to an ally or your hero.
cards.flavor: Luke took notes. Good notes.
cards.art: Hands binding a linen wound by lamplight, herbs and a bowl of water.

cards.name: Melchizedek
cards.text: Arrival: restore 3 to your hero.
cards.flavor: King of Salem, priest of God Most High, no genealogy, no exit. Mysterious on purpose. — Genesis 14.
cards.art: A haloless robed elder offering bread and a cup on a hilltop, dusk-gold, face in shadow.

cards.name: Eleazar the Faithful
cards.text: Endure.
cards.flavor: Carried the holy things and kept the count. Reliability as a spiritual gift.
cards.art: A priest bearing a covered vessel across a desert camp, careful step, incense-blue robes.

cards.name: Breaking of Bread
cards.text: Restore 2 to all allies and your hero.
cards.flavor: They knew Him in it. Then dinner got a lot more interesting. — Luke 24.
cards.art: Hands breaking a loaf at a simple table, warm amber light, two empty places implied.

cards.name: Ezra the Teacher
cards.text: Arrival: return a spell from your discard to your hand.
cards.flavor: Reopened the book and the whole nation wept. Good sermon. — Nehemiah 8.
cards.art: A scribe reading from a raised wooden platform to a vast crowd at dawn, scroll unrolled.

cards.name: The Bronze Serpent
cards.text: At the start of your turn, restore 2 to a damaged ally.
cards.flavor: Look and live. Deeply strange. Entirely the point. — Numbers 21.
cards.art: A serpent of burnished bronze coiled on a tall pole against a desert sky.

cards.name: Atonement
cards.text: Return your strongest fallen ally to the field with Endure.
cards.flavor: The scapegoat carried it all out into the wild. — Leviticus 16.
cards.art: A single goat walking toward a red-gold horizon of empty wilderness, weight lifted.

cards.name: The Tabernacle
cards.text: At the end of your turn, give a damaged ally +1/+1.
cards.flavor: A tent so holy it had a floor plan from Heaven. — Exodus 26.
cards.art: A glowing tent-shrine in a desert camp at night, pillar of cloud-fire above.

cards.name: Aaron, the High Priest
cards.text: Arrival: give all your units Endure this turn.
cards.flavor: Wore the names of the tribes on his chest. Also once made a very regrettable cow. — Exodus 28 / 32.
cards.art: A priest in a jeweled breastplate of twelve stones, censer smoking, incense-blue and gold.

cards.name: Samuel, Raised at the Altar
cards.text: Raise: once per turn, when an ally dies, restore it to 1 health.
cards.flavor: Lent to the Lord before he could walk. Grew up in the sanctuary. — 1 Samuel 1.
cards.art: A child in a tiny linen ephod tending an altar lamp, oversized temple around him, hush.

cards.name: Incense Offering
cards.text: Restore 3 to a character; if it's a Priest, draw a card.
cards.flavor: A sweet smell went up. Someone was paying attention. — Exodus 30.
cards.art: A censer trailing blue smoke over a golden altar, curling script of incense, hush.

cards.name: Consecration
cards.text: Give an ally +1/+2 and Endure.
cards.flavor: Set apart. Handle with care.
cards.art: Oil poured over a bowed head, gold droplets catching light, white-gold radiance.

cards.name: Hur, the Upholder
cards.text: At the end of your turn, give a damaged ally +1/+1.
cards.flavor: Held up Moses' arms all day so the battle would hold. Unsung MVP. — Exodus 17.
cards.art: Two figures bracing an old man's outstretched arms on a hilltop at dusk, a battle below.

cards.name: Phinehas the Zealous
cards.text: Arrival: deal 2 to an enemy unit.
cards.flavor: A priest who did not merely pray about it. The plague stopped. — Numbers 25.
cards.art: A priest striding forward with a spear, censer smoking at his belt, resolve.

cards.name: Zadok the High Priest
cards.text: Whenever you restore health, restore 1 more.
cards.flavor: Backed the right king when it counted. Anointed Solomon. — 1 Kings 1.
cards.art: A dignified high priest with an anointing horn, temple pillars behind, calm authority.

cards.name: Day of Atonement
cards.text: Restore your hero to full health.
cards.flavor: Once a year, the slate wiped clean. The whole point, in one day. — Leviticus 16.
cards.art: A lone goat walking toward a bright wilderness horizon, camp receding, weight lifting.

cards.name: Shepherd Boy
cards.text: Redeem: when this dies, summon a 1/1 Sheep.
cards.flavor: Somebody has to watch them. It's usually the youngest.
cards.art: A young shepherd leaning on a crook at dawn, a few sheep around his feet, green hills.

cards.name: Faithful Sheepdog
cards.text: Swift.
cards.flavor: Herds, guards, judges nobody. A very good boy.
cards.art: A lean herding dog mid-bound across a green slope, ears up, joyful purpose.

cards.name: Rachel at the Well
cards.text: Arrival: give an ally +0/+2.
cards.flavor: Jacob rolled the stone off the well single-handed to impress her. It worked. — Genesis 29.
cards.art: A young woman leading sheep to a stone well at golden hour, water gleaming.

cards.name: Amos the Herdsman
cards.text: Arrival: Foresee 1.
cards.flavor: Just a fig-farmer with opinions the powerful hated. — Amos 7.
cards.art: A rugged herdsman among figs and sheep pointing at a distant gilded city.

cards.name: Gather the Flock
cards.text: Summon two 1/1 Sheep.
cards.flavor: Ninety-eight to go.
cards.art: Sheep streaming through a gate into a stone fold at dusk, a shepherd counting.

cards.name: Not One Lost
cards.text: Return all friendly units that died this turn to the field with 1 health.
cards.flavor: He left the ninety-nine. The math is emotional, not arithmetic. — Luke 15.
cards.art: A shepherd hauling a single sheep up out of a ravine by lamplight, ninety-nine glowing on the hill.

cards.name: Jacob the Herdsman
cards.text: Covenant: at the start of your turn, give a Sheep +1/+1.
cards.flavor: Worked fourteen years for the wrong sister, then the right one. Patient, eventually. — Genesis 29.
cards.art: A young herdsman among speckled and spotted flocks at a watering trough.

cards.name: The Good Fold
cards.text: Your Sheep have +1/+1 and Guard.
cards.flavor: One door. One shepherd. Surprisingly cozy.
cards.art: A stone sheepfold with a single low gate, shepherd seated across the opening as a living door.

cards.name: David, the Shepherd
cards.text: Arrival: summon a 1/1 Sheep. Redeem: when a Sheep dies, deal 2 to a random enemy.
cards.flavor: Fought a lion and a bear over livestock. The giant was practice. — 1 Samuel 17.
cards.art: A shepherd youth with a harp on his back and a sling at his belt, a lion's shadow slinking off.

cards.name: Moses of Midian
cards.text: Arrival: summon two 1/1 Sheep. Redeem: your Sheep are immune to the first damage each turn.
cards.flavor: Spent forty years herding sheep and pretending he wasn't somebody. — Exodus 3.
cards.art: A weathered herdsman before a bush of unconsuming flame on a bare mountain, sandals off.

cards.name: Lost Sheep
cards.text: Redeem: when this dies, return it to your hand.
cards.flavor: It wandered off. He went and got it. Every time. — Luke 15.
cards.art: A single small sheep tangled in a thorny ravine at dusk, a lantern glow approaching.

cards.name: Ewe & Lamb
cards.text: Legacy: summon a 1/1 Sheep.
cards.flavor: The flock keeps going. That's rather the point.
cards.art: A ewe nuzzling a newborn lamb in green grass, dawn light, tender.

cards.name: Rod & Staff
cards.text: Give an ally +1/+2.
cards.flavor: They comfort me. Also, occasionally, they whack a wolf. — Psalm 23.
cards.art: A carved shepherd's crook and rod crossed on a rock, worn wood, warm morning light.

cards.name: Green Pastures
cards.text: Restore 2 health to all your units.
cards.flavor: He makes me lie down in them. Firmly, sometimes. — Psalm 23.
cards.art: Sheep resting in a lush valley beside still water, golden hour, deep calm.

cards.name: Sheepfold Gate
cards.text: At the start of your turn, summon a 1/1 Sheep.
cards.flavor: One door. The shepherd is the door. Surprisingly literal. — John 10.
cards.art: A low stone sheepfold with a single gap, a shepherd seated across it as a living gate, night.

cards.name: Jabez
cards.text: Arrival: gain +1/+1 for each Sheep you control.
cards.flavor: Prayed one bold little prayer. God said yes. Two verses, then gone. — 1 Chron 4.
cards.art: A humble herdsman kneeling among sheep, hands open, a quiet golden light around him.

cards.name: Abel, Keeper of Flocks
cards.text: Legacy: summon two 1/1 Sheep.
cards.flavor: Brought his very best. The first to understand the assignment. — Genesis 4.
cards.art: A young shepherd laying a lamb on a simple stone altar at dawn, reverent, dawn-green and cream.

cards.name: The Ninety-Nine
cards.text: Arrival: summon three 1/1 Sheep.
cards.flavor: He left all of them to go find the one. The math is emotional. — Luke 15.
cards.art: A vast hillside dotted with glowing sheep at dusk, one shepherd's lantern moving toward a stray.

cards.name: Firstborn Heir
cards.text: Vanilla.
cards.flavor: The first of many. Very, very many.
cards.art: A swaddled child held up against a vast starfield, tent and altar below, indigo awe.

cards.name: Eliezer the Steward
cards.text: Arrival: Foresee 2.
cards.flavor: Sent to find a bride. Came back with a caravan and a plan. — Genesis 24.
cards.art: A trusted servant loading gifts onto kneeling camels at a well, desert-tan dusk.

cards.name: Isaac
cards.text: Arrival: give an ally +1/+1.
cards.flavor: The promised one. Very nearly the plot twist. Let's not. — Genesis 22.
cards.art: A grown heir digging open an old well his father named, laughter in his face.

cards.name: Sarah
cards.text: Covenant: at the start of your turn, gain +1/+1.
cards.flavor: Laughed at the promise. God kept it anyway, and named the kid 'Laughter.' — Genesis 18.
cards.art: An elder woman at a tent door, hand to mouth mid-laugh, three visitors' long shadows.

cards.name: Sons of Jacob
cards.text: Legacy: summon a 1/1 Heir.
cards.flavor: Twelve of them. It got complicated fast. — Genesis 35.
cards.art: A rowdy group of brothers around a campfire, one in a bright coat slightly apart.

cards.name: Covenant of Stars
cards.text: Summon three 1/1 Heirs.
cards.flavor: Count the stars, if you can. Then keep counting. — Genesis 15.
cards.art: An old man gazing up at an overwhelming field of stars, arms open, tiny against indigo.

cards.name: The Birthright
cards.text: +1/+1; Legacy: draw a card.
cards.flavor: Sold once for a bowl of soup. History's worst trade. — Genesis 25.
cards.art: A carved family staff and mantle passed between two hands, one eager, one careless.

cards.name: Enoch
cards.text: Covenant: at the start of your third turn, exile Enoch and draw 2.
cards.flavor: Walked with God, and then simply… wasn't there. — Genesis 5:24.
cards.art: A robed figure mid-stride fading into gold light on a hilltop path, footprints stopping.

cards.name: Noah, Ark-Builder
cards.text: Arrival: summon two 1/1 Doves.
cards.flavor: Built a boat on dry land for a hundred years while the neighbors watched. — Genesis 6.
cards.art: A vast timber ark under construction on a dusty plain, pairs of animals filing up the ramp.

cards.name: Abram, the Called
cards.text: Fulfill: start your turn with 3+ other allies.
cards.flavor: Left everything on the strength of a voice and a promise. — Genesis 12.
cards.art: A lone traveler leaving a walled city at dawn with tents and flocks, road ahead empty.

cards.name: Abraham, Father of Nations
cards.text: Arrival: summon two 1/1 Heirs.
cards.flavor: A promise, kept and counted in the thousands.
cards.art: An old patriarch beneath a night sky thick with stars, descendants implied in the shadows.

cards.name: Jacob
cards.text: Fulfill: survive combat vs a stronger unit.
cards.flavor: Wrestled a stranger till dawn and wouldn't let go. Limped away renamed. — Genesis 32.
cards.art: Two figures locked in a wrestling hold at a river ford at first light, one radiant.

cards.name: Israel
cards.text: Your allies cost 1 less.
cards.flavor: He wrestled with God and prevailed, and walked with a limp forever after.
cards.art: A limping patriarch at dawn leaning on a staff, twelve tents behind him, gold light.

cards.name: Joseph the Dreamer
cards.text: If Joseph would die, exile him; returns in 2 turns as Joseph, Lord of Egypt.
cards.flavor: Pit, prison, palace. In that exact order. Kept the receipts. — Genesis 37–41.
cards.art: A youth in a torn bright-colored coat lowered into a dry pit, brothers above; faint gold throne.

cards.name: Joseph, Lord of Egypt
cards.text: Arrival: draw 2.
cards.flavor: From the pit to the right hand of Pharaoh. He fed nations and forgave brothers.
cards.art: A robed Egyptian vizier with a gold collar overseeing granaries, dignified, desert-gold.

cards.name: Moses the Lawgiver
cards.text: Covenant: at the start of your turn, add a random Exodus card to your hand.
cards.flavor: Came down the mountain with the rules and a glowing face nobody could look at. — Exodus 34.
cards.art: An elder descending a smoking peak with two stone tablets, face luminous, veiled crowd below.

cards.name: Terah's Caravan
cards.text: Arrival: your next card this turn costs 1 less.
cards.flavor: Started the journey. Didn't finish it. Somebody had to pack the tents. — Genesis 11.
cards.art: A laden caravan of camels and tents setting out from a walled city at dawn, desert-tan.

cards.name: Keturah's Heirs
cards.text: Legacy: summon two 1/1 Heirs.
cards.flavor: Abraham had a whole second family later on. The man kept his promises coming. — Genesis 25.
cards.art: A cluster of children around an elder patriarch beneath a tent awning, starfield beyond.

cards.name: Covenant Renewed
cards.text: Give your Heirs +1/+1.
cards.flavor: The same promise, said again to the next one. And the next. — Genesis 26.
cards.art: An altar of uncut stones under a sky of countless stars, a hand raised in oath.

cards.name: Well of the Oath
cards.text: Covenant: at the start of your turn, give a random ally +1/+1.
cards.flavor: Beersheba — 'the well of the oath.' They dug it, argued over it, swore peace on it. — Genesis 21.
cards.art: An ancient stone well in the desert at first light, seven ewes beside it, long shadows.

cards.name: Land of Promise
cards.text: Covenant: summon a 1/1 Heir. If you control 6+ units, give them all +1/+1.
cards.flavor: Milk, honey, and a very long wait. — Exodus 3.
cards.art: A ridge overlooking a green valley of rivers and groves, a lone figure gazing from dry heights.

cards.name: Andrew the First
cards.text: Arrival: give an ally +1/+0.
cards.flavor: Kept quietly bringing people to meet someone. — John 1.
cards.art: A fisherman tugging a friend by the sleeve toward off-frame light, nets and lakeshore.

cards.name: Eager Convert
cards.text: Scatter: when this dies, summon a 1/1 Disciple.
cards.flavor: New, loud, and absolutely everywhere.
cards.art: A wide-eyed newcomer clutching a scroll to their chest in a crowded doorway, amber lamplight.

cards.name: Philip
cards.text: Swift. Arrival: Foresee 2.
cards.flavor: Ran alongside a moving chariot to start a conversation. Commitment. — Acts 8.
cards.art: A robed man jogging beside a rolling chariot on a desert road, scroll in hand.

cards.name: Thomas
cards.text: Arrival: Foresee 1; if it's a Legendary, draw it.
cards.flavor: He'll believe it when he sees it. To be fair — he did. — John 20.
cards.art: A skeptical man reaching out a cautious hand toward off-frame light, brow furrowed.

cards.name: Stephen
cards.text: Scatter: when this dies, summon two 1/1 Disciples.
cards.flavor: The first to fall. The church only scattered — and spread faster. — Acts 7.
cards.art: A kneeling young deacon looking up into breaking golden light, calm amid gathering shadow.

cards.name: Barnabas
cards.text: Arrival: give an ally +2/+2.
cards.flavor: 'Son of Encouragement.' Vouched for the guy literally nobody else trusted. — Acts 9.
cards.art: A warm-faced man with an arm around a wary outsider, introducing him to a skeptical circle.

cards.name: The Upper Room
cards.text: Summon two 1/1 Disciples.
cards.flavor: Room for everyone. BYO fish. — Acts 1.
cards.art: A lamplit upper chamber with cushions and low tables, a stair leading up, expectant.

cards.name: Silas
cards.text: Arrival: if an ally has died this game, gain +1/+1 and Swift.
cards.flavor: Sang hymns in a midnight jail. The doors fell off. — Acts 16.
cards.art: Two prisoners singing in a torchlit cell as chains loosen and a doorframe cracks with light.

cards.name: Pentecost
cards.text: Summon three 1/1 Disciples with Swift.
cards.flavor: Everyone heard it in their own language. The one time a crowd's confusion was a miracle. — Acts 2.
cards.art: Small tongues of flame resting over a gathered crowd's heads in an upper room, amber wonder.

cards.name: Great Commission
cards.text: Your Disciples get +2/+2.
cards.flavor: Go everywhere. Tell everyone. Alarmingly literal instructions. — Matthew 28.
cards.art: A wide dawn horizon with roads branching toward distant cities, small figures setting out.

cards.name: Dorcas
cards.text: Legacy: return Dorcas to your hand (once per game).
cards.flavor: So loved they sent for Peter himself. Wouldn't stay down. — Acts 9.
cards.art: A seamstress surrounded by widows holding up garments she made, warm workshop.

cards.name: Simon the Fisherman
cards.text: Fulfill: survive damage.
cards.flavor: Ready to walk on water. Also ready to immediately need rescuing. Both true. — Matthew 14.
cards.art: A burly fisherman stepping off a boat onto choppy water, one foot sinking, hand reaching up.

cards.name: Peter, the Rock
cards.text: Guard.
cards.flavor: On this rock. — Matthew 16.
cards.art: A solid, steady apostle standing firm with arms crossed before a stone doorway, dawn light.

cards.name: Saul of Tarsus
cards.text: Arrival: your other allies -1 attack this turn. At the start of your next turn, transforms into Paul, Apostle.
cards.flavor: The one transformation you don't earn. That's the entire point. — Acts 9.
cards.art: A hard-eyed man on a road struck by a blinding column of light, thrown from his mount.

cards.name: Paul, Apostle
cards.text: On transform: draw 2.
cards.flavor: The letters that built the church, from the man who tried to end it.
cards.art: A seated figure writing by lamplight in a spare cell, chains at his ankle, amber glow.

cards.name: Apollos
cards.text: Arrival: draw 2 spells.
cards.flavor: Eloquent, mighty in Scripture, and still willing to be corrected by tentmakers. — Acts 18.
cards.art: A dynamic orator mid-gesture before a rapt synagogue crowd, scroll aloft, conviction.

cards.name: Timothy
cards.text: Arrival: give a Disciple +1/+1.
cards.flavor: Young, and told not to let anyone hold that against him. — 1 Timothy 4.
cards.art: A youthful figure reading a letter intently by lamplight, satchel and scroll, amber warmth.

cards.name: Matthias
cards.text: Scatter: when this dies, summon a 1/1 Disciple.
cards.flavor: Won the only apostolic coin-toss in history. Then vanished into faithful obscurity. — Acts 1.
cards.art: A plain, steady disciple standing among the Twelve, unremarkable and reliable, amber light.

cards.name: Ruth
cards.text: Whenever another ally dies, gain +1/+1.
cards.flavor: 'Where you go, I go.' Even here. Especially here. — Ruth 1.
cards.art: A young widow gleaning barley behind harvesters in golden fields, resolve, warm dust-light.

cards.name: Boaz
cards.text: Guard. Has +1/+1 while you control Ruth.
cards.flavor: The kinsman-redeemer. Did it properly, at the gate, with witnesses. — Ruth 4.
cards.art: A landowner speaking at a city gate before elders, a sandal changing hands.

cards.name: Watchman
cards.text: Guard.
cards.flavor: It's a living. Mostly standing. — Ezekiel 33.
cards.art: A lone sentry on a night wall with a horn, torch guttering, long shadows, vigilance.

cards.name: Shepherd
cards.text: Vanilla.
cards.flavor: A perfectly fine 1/1. Somebody has to be.
cards.art: A simple herdsman with a crook on a plain hillside, unremarkable and content.

cards.name: Scribe
cards.text: Arrival: Foresee 1.
cards.flavor: Measure twice, copy once.
cards.art: A copyist at a desk with quill and scroll, careful and quiet, lamplight.

cards.name: Physician
cards.text: Arrival: restore 3 to an ally.
cards.flavor: Beloved. Also took excellent notes. — Colossians 4.
cards.art: A healer mixing herbs in a bowl beside a resting patient, clean linen, gentle amber light.

cards.name: Musician
cards.text: At the end of your turn, give a random ally +1/+0.
cards.flavor: Played until the darkness lifted. Requests were not taken.
cards.art: A player of a ten-stringed lyre by firelight, eyes closed, notes almost visible in the air.

cards.name: Craftsman
cards.text: Arrival: draw a Relic from your deck.
cards.flavor: Filled with skill for the work of it. — Exodus 31.
cards.art: An artisan carving acacia wood by lamplight, curls of shaving, tools in careful order.

cards.name: Cupbearer
cards.text: Arrival: draw a card.
cards.flavor: Trusted with the king's cup — and, it turns out, his ear. — Nehemiah 1.
cards.art: A palace servant presenting a golden cup, downcast eyes hiding a heavy heart, marble.

cards.name: Gatekeeper
cards.text: Guard.
cards.flavor: You're not on the list. There is no list. Same result.
cards.art: A broad doorkeeper filling a temple gateway, arms folded, torch-lit stone, immovable.

cards.name: Scarlet Cord
cards.text: +0/+2; Legacy: draw a card.
cards.flavor: One red thread in a window saved a whole household. — Joshua 2.
cards.art: A scarlet cord tied at a window in a city wall, dawn behind, a sign of a hidden promise.

cards.name: Naaman the Healed
cards.text: Arrival: restore 4 to your hero.
cards.flavor: Dipped seven times in a muddy river. Swallowed his pride exactly once. — 2 Kings 5.
cards.art: A once-proud general rising from a brown river, skin made new, armor on the bank.

cards.name: The Widow's Mite
cards.text: Give an ally +1/+1. If it's the only card in your hand, give +3/+3 instead.
cards.flavor: She gave everything. The rich gave leftovers. Heaven noticed. — Mark 12.
cards.art: A worn hand dropping two tiny copper coins into a temple chest, rich robes blurred behind.

cards.name: Melchizedek's Blessing
cards.text: Restore 4 to your hero; draw a card.
cards.flavor: Bread, wine, and a blessing from nowhere in the genealogy. — Genesis 14.
cards.art: An outstretched hand over bread and a cup on a hilltop, gold dusk, giver's face in shadow.

cards.name: Job
cards.text: Whenever Job takes damage, at the start of your next turn restore him to full and give +1/+1.
cards.flavor: Lost everything, argued with God for forty chapters, got more back. Endurance, defined. — Job 42.
cards.art: A gaunt man seated on ash in tattered robes, storm clearing to gold behind, unbroken gaze upward.

cards.name: Onesimus
cards.text: Legacy: return Onesimus to your hand.
cards.flavor: Ran away a slave, came back a brother. The letter that changed it is one page long. — Philemon.
cards.art: A traveler at a doorway holding a folded letter, uncertain hope on his face, warm threshold.

tokens.name: Sheep
tokens.art: A small fluffy sheep, wool-cream, wide innocent eyes.

tokens.name: Heir
tokens.art: A child in simple robes against a starfield, hopeful.

tokens.name: Disciple
tokens.art: A traveler with a staff and satchel on a dawn road, amber light.

tokens.name: Dove
tokens.flavor: It came back with an olive leaf. — Genesis 8.
tokens.art: A white dove in flight with an olive sprig, soft light over water.

tokens.name: Mantle of Elijah
tokens.flavor: A double portion, for whoever picks it up next. — 2 Kings 2.
tokens.art: A prophet's cloak on a riverbank, still warm, glowing faintly at the hem.

tokens.name: Assyrian Soldier
tokens.art: A helmeted spearman of the Assyrian host, cold bronze.

tokens.name: Locust
tokens.art: A single locust, wings blurred, ochre sky.

adversary.name: Goliath of Gath
adversary.text: On paper, unbeatable.
adversary.art: A towering armored giant with a spear, helmet, ominous.

adversary.name: Egyptian Taskmaster
adversary.art: A whip-bearing overseer, cold palette.

adversary.name: Philistine Soldier
adversary.art: A helmeted soldier with spear, steel-blue.

adversary.name: Amalekite Raider
adversary.text: Swift.
adversary.art: A fast desert rider, dust and motion.

adversary.name: Chariot of Iron
adversary.text: Guard.
adversary.art: An iron war-chariot, spoked wheels, bronze.

adversary.name: Jezebel
adversary.text: Arrival: deal 2 to a random enemy unit.
adversary.art: A cold, ornate queen at a high window, kohl and gold, menace.

adversary.name: Pharaoh's Magician
adversary.text: Arrival: draw a card.
adversary.art: A court sorcerer with a serpent-staff, torchlit.

adversary.name: Idol of Ba'al
adversary.text: Guard.
adversary.art: A looming bronze idol on a plinth, cold fire.

adversary.name: The Serpent
adversary.text: "Did He really say that?"
adversary.flavor: The one villain line that lands with a chill, not a laugh.
adversary.art: A coiled serpent among branches, a single gleaming eye, shadow.

adversary.name: Pharaoh, the Hardened
adversary.text: Arrival: the enemy's units can't attack next turn.
adversary.art: An enthroned king of Egypt, arms crossed, cold gold, a river of shadow behind.

adversary.name: Haman the Agagite
adversary.text: Legacy: the gallows he built fall on the strongest enemy unit.
adversary.art: A sneering vizier beside an enormous empty gallows, torchlight, dread irony.

adversary.name: Nebuchadnezzar
adversary.text: Arrival: deal 3 to all enemy units without Guard.
adversary.art: A colossal golden statue with a king enthroned before it, furnace-glow.

adversary.name: Herod
adversary.text: Arrival: destroy the enemy's cheapest unit.
adversary.art: A paranoid king on a too-large throne, soldiers in shadow, cold marble.

adversary.name: Sennacherib's Host
adversary.text: Arrival: summon two 2/2 Assyrian Soldiers.
adversary.art: A vast siege camp bristling with spears outside a walled city at dusk.

adversary.name: Delilah
adversary.text: Arrival: an enemy unit loses its keywords and gets -2 attack.
adversary.art: An elegant figure with shears, a sleeping strongman's silhouette, candlelit betrayal.

adversary.name: Absalom
adversary.text: Swift. Legacy: deal 2 to the enemy hero.
adversary.art: A proud prince on a mule beneath a great oak, long hair, storm light.

adversary.name: Sisera
adversary.text: Guard.
adversary.art: An iron-chariot commander surveying a plain, bronze and cruelty.

adversary.name: The Witch of Endor
adversary.text: Arrival: return a fallen Adversary from the discard.
adversary.art: A dim cave, a hooded figure over a guttering fire, cold blue smoke.

adversary.name: Sanballat & Tobiah
adversary.text: Arrival: an enemy relic costs 2 more to activate.
adversary.art: Two mocking officials pointing at a half-built wall, sneers, dusty ridge.

adversary.name: Leviathan
adversary.text: Guard. Takes no damage from spells.
adversary.art: A vast sea-serpent coiling through black water, moonlight on scales — awe, not gore.

adversary.name: Behemoth
adversary.text: Endure.
adversary.art: An enormous beast at a marsh's edge, cedar-strong, dawn mist.

adversary.name: The Golden Calf
adversary.text: At the end of the Adversary's turn, give a random Adversary +1/+1.
adversary.art: A gilded calf idol on a pedestal, revelers' shadows, firelight.
